name: crystal_kit
author: rasta-mouse, nickswink, licitrasimone, jm33-ng
comment: Run Crystal Palace PICO shellcode in memory (ported from licitrasimone/crystal-kit-sliver)

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Crystal Palace PICO .bin shellcode to execute (agent local path or memfs:///path)

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional runtime arguments passed to the PICO entry / post-ex DLL

name: crystal_pack
author: rasta-mouse, nickswink, licitrasimone, jm33-ng
comment: Convert a Windows DLL into Crystal Palace PICO shellcode (postex-loader, ror13)

parameters.name: dll
parameters.description: Path to the Windows DLL to wrap into PICO (C2 local path)

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output .bin shellcode path (default: <dll>.pico.bin next to the input DLL)

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional args baked into the PICO at link time
